AutoStore™ holds a simple yet powerful vision: to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. Founded in Norway, we've grown into a global technology company. AutoStore uses advanced software to automate and orchestrate order fulfillment. Our goal is to ensure orders arrive faster than ever, with minimal environmental impact. That's how we help brands exceed customer expectations.

We have more than 1600 systems in nearly 60 countries, and we grow continuously as a community of employees, partners, customers, suppliers, and connected technologies. Automation should make life easier, and by listening carefully to our community, we innovate to meet the industry's most complex needs. With AutoStore™, brands gain speed, efficiency, and improved workplaces. And much more floor space.

AutoStore – moving things forward.

The Role:

AutoStore is hiring an Entry-Level Software Engineer to join our team at the start of their career. You will help design, build, and test the software that powers our automated storage and fulfillment systems, working alongside experienced engineers on real production code.

We are looking for a recent graduate with a strong academic record and, ideally, some internship experience. You don't need to know everything on day one. What matters most is a genuine passion for software, curiosity about how things work, and an eagerness to learn quickly.

You will receive structured mentoring and hands-on training, including in C++ and Python, the core languages our team works with.

Software Development

Apply object-oriented design principles and follow the team's coding standards.

Debug and troubleshoot issues, and learn to find root causes.
Take part in code reviews, both receiving feedback and reviewing teammates' code as you grow.

Collaboration and Delivery

Work in an agile team, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
Use Git and GitHub for version control, pull requests, and code reviews.
Work with QA, DevOps, and product teammates to deliver working software.

Learning and Growth

Develop your C++ and Python skills on the job through training, mentoring, and real project work.
Write and update technical documentation as you learn our systems.
Ask questions early and often, and share what you learn with the team.

Key Qualifications:

Working knowledge of C++ and Python, or of another object-oriented programming language (e.g., Java, C#).
If your experience is in a language other than C++ and Python, a commitment to learning both on the job.
Basic familiarity with Git and version control.
A genuine passion for technology and a strong eagerness to learn.
Good problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate clearly in a team.
Cumulative GPA (CGPA) of 3.5 or higher on a 4.0 scale, or equivalent.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, completed recently or within the next six months.

Exposure to unit testing frameworks (e.g., GoogleTest, pytest).

Experience with networking and communication protocols, including TCP/IP, MQTT, REST APIs, and WebSockets.

Daily hands-on use of AI development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Q Developer, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or Kiro

jobs.description:
Job Description

Sr. Software Developer III (Hybrid)

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

At Globe Life, we are committed to empowering our employees with the support and opportunities they need to succeed at every stage of their career. We take pride in fostering a caring and innovative culture that enables us to collectively grow and overcome challenges in a connected, collaborative, and mutually respectful environment that calls us to help Make Tomorrow Better.

Role Overview

Could you be our next Sr. Software Developer III
? Globe Life is looking for a Sr. Software Developer III
to join the team!

In this role, you will be responsible for providing technical support and guidance across system applications while driving enhancements and designing scalable solutions throughout the full application lifecycle. You will serve as a technical expert making architectural decisions, ensuring quality, and bridging technical execution with business needs for both new and existing applications. You will also manage client relationships with a high sense of urgency, providing technical guidance and hands-on support across end-user, application, and cloud environments.

This is a hybrid position located in McKinney, TX. (WFH Monday & Friday, In Office Tuesday–Thursday).

What You Will Do

Application Development

Design, build, and ship full-stack web applications from requirements through production release, owning quality, performance, and reliability throughout.
Build complex, data-driven, multi-user web applications that handle real-world load, concurrency, and security requirements.
Ensure web applications are maintainable, well-tested, well-documented, and built to last.
Take full ownership of features end-to-end: front-end UI, back-end API, data layer, and deployment.
Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, security vulnerabilities, and scalability issues.
Participate in production support, diagnosing, triaging, and resolving application issues in live environments.

Front-End

Own the front-end architecture, making deliberate, well-reasoned decisions about component structure, state management, routing strategy, data fetching patterns, and build configuration.
Build production-quality Vue 3 applications using the Composition API, script setup syntax, composables, provide/inject, teleport, and advanced slot patterns.
Design and enforce a scalable, maintainable component library with reusable, well-documented, and prop-typed components that the team can build on confidently.
Write TypeScript across the entire front-end codebase, including strict mode, well-defined interfaces, generic types, utility types, and proper type narrowing.
Architect state management with a clear separation of state, getters, and actions, applying the right approach for each situation.
Configure and optimize Vite build pipelines, including code splitting, tree shaking, lazy-loaded routes, dynamic imports, chunk strategy, and bundle size analysis.
Build responsive, mobile-first UIs using modern CSS, including Flexbox, Grid, SCSS/SASS, CSS custom properties, and BEM or equivalent methodology.
Implement and enforce WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards, including semantic HTML, ARIA roles and attributes, keyboard navigation, focus management, and screen reader compatibility.
Own front-end performance, optimizing Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, FID/INP), implementing lazy loading, virtual scrolling, debounce/throttle strategies, and memoization.
Handle complex client-side concerns including authentication flows (JWT, OAuth2, token refresh), route guards, role-based UI rendering, and secure token storage patterns.
Design robust API integration layers with interceptors, centralized error handling, retry logic, loading/error/empty states, and optimistic UI updates.
Write comprehensive front-end tests, including unit/component tests and end-to-end tests with Playwright or Cypress.
Collaborate closely with UX/UI designers to translate wireframes and mockups into pixel-perfect, accessible, performant implementations.
Ensure cross-browser and cross-device compatibility across Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and major mobile browsers.
Stay current with front-end tooling and web standards and bring forward-thinking recommendations to the team.

Back-End

Design and deliver full-stack features end-to-end, from front-end through .NET Core Web API.
Architect and implement RESTful APIs using ASP.NET Core Web API, including versioning, error handling, input validation, middleware pipelines, and security best practices.
Build and maintain back-end services using C# and .NET Core with clean architecture principles.
Implement authentication and authorization using JWT bearer tokens, OAuth2/OpenID Connect, and ASP.NET Core Identity.
Develop data access layers using Entity Framework Core and Dapper for performance-critical queries.
Design and optimize Microsoft SQL Server schemas, stored procedures, indexes, and T-SQL queries.
Implement background processing and messaging using Hangfire, AWS SQS, or Azure Service Bus.
Write clean, testable code and implement unit and integration tests as part of the development workflow.

DevOps & CI/CD

Own and continuously improve multi-stage CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, including build, automated testing, code quality gates, approval gates, and environment-specific releases.
Enforce Git best practices including branching strategy (GitFlow or trunk-based), pull request standards, code review quality, and release tagging.
Automate front-end and back-end testing and deployment processes within the pipeline.
Maintain Azure DevOps Boards and contribute to sprint planning and backlog refinement.

Leadership & Collaboration

Serve as the front-end authority on the team, setting standards and guiding others through complex front-end challenges.
Lead code reviews with substantive, constructive feedback that elevates code quality and team capability.
Mentor junior and mid-level developers, especially on front-end architecture, Vue 3 patterns, TypeScript, and performance.
Drive architecture and design discussions, creating technical specifications, component diagrams, and ADRs.
Partner with QA, DBAs, Business Analysts, and Product Owners throughout the full SDLC.
Proactively identify technical debt, propose remediation plans, and lead modernization efforts.
Participate in all Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and backlog grooming.

What You Can Bring

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience.

Experience

10+ years of overall software development experience, including 7+ years of expert-level front-end development (Vue 3 or Angular), 5+ years of full-stack .NET Core development, 4+ years of production TypeScript and Git, and 3+ years each of hands-on AWS, Azure DevOps CI/CD, and Microsoft SQL Server experience.
Demonstrated history of building and delivering complex, production web applications, enterprise or consumer-facing with real users, real data, and real uptime requirements.
Expert-level front-end framework experience including:
Vue 3 (preferred), Composition API, TypeScript, Pinia, Vue Router, Vite, and large-scale application architecture.
Angular considered as a strong alternative, with expert-level experience in TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx or similar state management, Angular CLI, and a genuine enthusiasm to transition to Vue 3.

Demonstrated experience leading or significantly contributing to front-end architecture decisions on a production application.
Proven experience in Agile/Scrum environments with iterative delivery and continuous improvement.
Proven ability to work independently through ambiguity, managing several diverse and complex problems simultaneously, and consistently delivering quality results that meet requirements and timelines.
Proven ability to think beyond individual components, with experience contributing to system design, platform strategy, and broad technical direction.
Demonstrated ability to resolve and de-escalate issues effectively and independently.
Proven understanding of how end users interact with their applications, using that perspective to drive better outcomes.

Technical Skills

Mastery-level front-end engineering expertise, with a track record of owning deliverables, raising team capability, and delivering reliable production outcomes.

Deep experience with advanced Vue 3 patterns including composables, provide/inject, teleport, and advanced slot patterns.
Hands-on experience with Pinia / NgRx state management, Vue Router 4, and Angular Router.
Advanced TypeScript skills including discriminated unions and complex type narrowing patterns.
Solid foundation in JavaScript ES6+, HTML5 (semantic/ARIA), and CSS3 (Flexbox, Grid, SCSS/BEM).
Proven ability to optimize web performance including Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, and bundle optimization.
Experience implementing auth patterns and security practices including JWT, OAuth2/OIDC (PKCE), route guards, role-based UI, secure token storage, XSS, CSRF, and CSP.
Experience with testing frameworks including Vitest/Jest, Vue Test Utils, Angular Testing Library, Playwright/Cypress, xUnit, Moq/NSubstitute, and FluentAssertions.
Demonstrated ability to implement and enforce accessibility standards including WCAG 2.1 AA, keyboard navigation, and screen reader testing.
Proficiency with Clean Architecture principles including CQRS/MediatR, Repository pattern, and SOLID.
Hands-on experience with EF Core, Dapper, FluentValidation, Redis caching, and EF Core code-first migrations.
Working knowledge of ASP.NET Core Identity and C# features including async/await, LINQ, records, and pattern matching.
Proficiency with Docker and SonarQube/SonarCloud.
Proactive approach to problem solving with the ability to quickly analyze situations, identify solutions, deliver clear informed recommendations, and understand the impact on time, cost, and quality.

Preferred

Familiarity with Redis, PostgreSQL, SQS/SNS, ECS/Fargate, GitHub Actions, or Terraform is a plus.

Relevant certifications, including AWS (e.g., AWS Certified Developer, Associate or Solutions Architect), are a plus.

Applicable To All Employees of Globe Life Family of Companies:

Reliable and predictable attendance of your assigned shift.
Ability to work full time and/or part time based on the position specifications.

How Globe Life Will Support You

Looking to continue your career in an environment that values your contribution and invests in your growth? We've curated a benefits package that helps to ensure that you don’t just work, but thrive at Globe Life:

Competitive compensation designed to reflect your expertise and contribution.
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans because your well-being is fundamental to your performance.
Robust life insurance benefits and retirement plans, including company-matched 401k and pension plan.

Company-paid counseling for assistance with mental health, stress management, and work-life balance.
Continued education reimbursement eligibility and company-paid FLMI and ICA courses to grow your career.
Discounted Texas Rangers tickets for a proud visit to Globe Life Field.

Opportunity awaits! Invest in your professional legacy, realize your path, and see the direct impact you can make in a workplace that celebrates and harnesses your unique talents and perspectives to their fullest potential. At Globe Life, your voice matters.

Role Summary

The Infotainment Platform team at Rivian Volkswagen Technologies is looking for a skilled Platform Engineer to join our Automotive Software team. We are developing the next generation, Android-based in-vehicle experience that will be deployed across all future electric vehicles in the Rivian and Volkswagen Group portfolios. In this role, you will own the architecture and implementation of the display subsystem, ensuring that pixels travel from applications to the physical screens efficiently, correctly, and reliably.

You will work deep within the display and graphics stack, bridging the gap between high-level applications and low-level hardware drivers. You will be responsible for enabling complex multi-display setups, optimizing display and graphics performance, and ensuring the stability of the visual experience in our next-generation vehicles.

Key Responsibilities

Display & Graphics Stack Ownership: Design, develop, and maintain the display pipeline across both Android and non-Android platforms — focusing on SurfaceFlinger, Window Manager, and the Hardware Composer (HWC) HAL on Android, and equivalent compositor/display-server stacks such as Wayland/Weston and OpenWF Display (OpenWFD) on QNX/Linux-based systems.
Multi-Display Architecture: Engineer solutions for complex automotive display topologies, including Instrument Clusters, Central Infotainment (IVI), Passenger Displays, and Rear Seat Entertainment systems.
SoC Display Bring-Up & Integration: Partner directly with automotive infotainment SoC vendors to bring up and validate new display panels and interfaces on target hardware, spanning both Android and non-Android display stacks (e.g. OpenWF Display / OpenWFD on QNX-based systems, and Wayland/Weston compositors on Linux-based systems).

HAL & Driver Integration: Work with SoC vendors to integrate and debug display drivers, ensuring proper communication between the Android Framework and the Kernel (DRM/KMS).
Stability & Robustness: Investigate and resolve stability issues such as screen freezes, black screens, and graphical artifacts. Analyze ANRs and native crashes related to the display/graphics stack.
Feature Development: Implement custom display features such as dynamic resolution switching, content mirroring, and hardware-accelerated layering/composition.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the Hardware, Kernel, and HMI Application teams to define requirements and resolve cross-layer dependencies.

Minimum Qualifications

BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of experience in embedded software development or platform engineering.
Strong proficiency in C++ and C. Familiarity with Java/Kotlin for Android Framework debugging.
Deep understanding of Android framework components like SurfaceFlinger, BufferQueue, and the Android display/graphics architecture.
Experience implementing or debugging HIDL/AIDL interfaces, specifically the Hardware Composer (HWC) or Gralloc.
Solid understanding of Linux OS internals, memory management (Ion/Dmabuf), and multi-threading.
Familiarity with low level display HW including Serializer/Deserializer, video links and display interfaces.
Hands-on experience integrating and bringing up new displays on automotive infotainment SoCs (e.g. Qualcomm Snapdragon Cockpit/Ride, NXP i.MX, TI Jacinto), including working knowledge of non-Android display compositor stacks such as OpenWF Display (OpenWFD) and Wayland/Weston.
Proficiency with version control systems like Git.

Preferred Qualifications

Low-Level Display: Knowledge of Linux DRM/KMS (Direct Rendering Manager / Kernel Mode Setting) subsystem and V4L2.
Automotive Standards: Experience with Android Automotive OS (AAOS) specific features like EVS (Exterior View System) or Cluster display management.
Functional Safety: Familiarity with display related automotive functional safety aspects.
Virtualization: Familiarity with display virtualization (VirtIO-GPU) and hypervisor environments (e.g., QNX, Gunyah).
SoC Experience: Experience bringing up display stacks on major automotive SoCs (Qualcomm Snapdragon, MediaTek, NXP, etc.).
Tools: Proficiency with performance profiling tools like Systrace, Perfetto, and vendor-specific GPU profilers.
Graphics APIs: Experience with OpenGL ES, Vulkan, or EGL.

Could you be our next Sr. Software Developer III
? Globe Life is looking for a Sr. Software Developer III
to join the team!

In this role, you will be responsible for providing technical support and guidance across system applications while driving enhancements and designing scalable solutions throughout the full application lifecycle. You will serve as a technical expert making architectural decisions, ensuring quality, and bridging technical execution with business needs for both new and existing applications. You will also manage client relationships with a high sense of urgency, providing technical guidance and hands-on support across end-user, application, and cloud environments.

This is a hybrid position located in McKinney, TX. (WFH Monday & Friday, In Office Tuesday–Thursday).

Application Development

Design, build, and ship full-stack web applications from requirements through production release, owning quality, performance, and reliability throughout.
Build complex, data-driven, multi-user web applications that handle real-world load, concurrency, and security requirements.
Ensure web applications are maintainable, well-tested, well-documented, and built to last.
Take full ownership of features end-to-end: front-end UI, back-end API, data layer, and deployment.
Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, security vulnerabilities, and scalability issues.
Participate in production support, diagnosing, triaging, and resolving application issues in live environments.

Front-End

Own the front-end architecture, making deliberate, well-reasoned decisions about component structure, state management, routing strategy, data fetching patterns, and build configuration.
Build production-quality Vue 3 applications using the Composition API, script setup syntax, composables, provide/inject, teleport, and advanced slot patterns.
Design and enforce a scalable, maintainable component library with reusable, well-documented, and prop-typed components that the team can build on confidently.
Write TypeScript across the entire front-end codebase, including strict mode, well-defined interfaces, generic types, utility types, and proper type narrowing.
Architect state management with a clear separation of state, getters, and actions, applying the right approach for each situation.
Configure and optimize Vite build pipelines, including code splitting, tree shaking, lazy-loaded routes, dynamic imports, chunk strategy, and bundle size analysis.
Build responsive, mobile-first UIs using modern CSS, including Flexbox, Grid, SCSS/SASS, CSS custom properties, and BEM or equivalent methodology.
Implement and enforce WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards, including semantic HTML, ARIA roles and attributes, keyboard navigation, focus management, and screen reader compatibility.
Own front-end performance, optimizing Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, FID/INP), implementing lazy loading, virtual scrolling, debounce/throttle strategies, and memoization.
Handle complex client-side concerns including authentication flows (JWT, OAuth2, token refresh), route guards, role-based UI rendering, and secure token storage patterns.
Design robust API integration layers with interceptors, centralized error handling, retry logic, loading/error/empty states, and optimistic UI updates.
Write comprehensive front-end tests, including unit/component tests and end-to-end tests with Playwright or Cypress.
Collaborate closely with UX/UI designers to translate wireframes and mockups into pixel-perfect, accessible, performant implementations.
Ensure cross-browser and cross-device compatibility across Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and major mobile browsers.
Stay current with front-end tooling and web standards and bring forward-thinking recommendations to the team.

Back-End

Design and deliver full-stack features end-to-end, from front-end through .NET Core Web API.
Architect and implement RESTful APIs using ASP.NET Core Web API, including versioning, error handling, input validation, middleware pipelines, and security best practices.
Build and maintain back-end services using C# and .NET Core with clean architecture principles.
Implement authentication and authorization using JWT bearer tokens, OAuth2/OpenID Connect, and ASP.NET Core Identity.
Develop data access layers using Entity Framework Core and Dapper for performance-critical queries.
Design and optimize Microsoft SQL Server schemas, stored procedures, indexes, and T-SQL queries.
Implement background processing and messaging using Hangfire, AWS SQS, or Azure Service Bus.
Write clean, testable code and implement unit and integration tests as part of the development workflow.

DevOps & CI/CD

Own and continuously improve multi-stage CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, including build, automated testing, code quality gates, approval gates, and environment-specific releases.
Enforce Git best practices including branching strategy (GitFlow or trunk-based), pull request standards, code review quality, and release tagging.
Automate front-end and back-end testing and deployment processes within the pipeline.
Maintain Azure DevOps Boards and contribute to sprint planning and backlog refinement.

Leadership & Collaboration

Serve as the front-end authority on the team, setting standards and guiding others through complex front-end challenges.
Lead code reviews with substantive, constructive feedback that elevates code quality and team capability.
Mentor junior and mid-level developers, especially on front-end architecture, Vue 3 patterns, TypeScript, and performance.
Drive architecture and design discussions, creating technical specifications, component diagrams, and ADRs.
Partner with QA, DBAs, Business Analysts, and Product Owners throughout the full SDLC.
Proactively identify technical debt, propose remediation plans, and lead modernization efforts.
Participate in all Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and backlog grooming.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience.

Experience

10+ years of overall software development experience, including 7+ years of expert-level front-end development (Vue 3 or Angular), 5+ years of full-stack .NET Core development, 4+ years of production TypeScript and Git, and 3+ years each of hands-on AWS, Azure DevOps CI/CD, and Microsoft SQL Server experience.

About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

The Infotainment Platform team at Rivian Volkswagen Technologies is looking for a skilled Platform Engineer to join our Automotive Software team. We are developing the next generation, Android-based in-vehicle experience that will be deployed across all future electric vehicles in the Rivian and Volkswagen Group portfolios. In this role, you will own the architecture and implementation of the display subsystem, ensuring that pixels travel from applications to the physical screens efficiently, correctly, and reliably.

You will work deep within the display and graphics stack, bridging the gap between high-level applications and low-level hardware drivers. You will be responsible for enabling complex multi-display setups, optimizing display and graphics performance, and ensuring the stability of the visual experience in our next-generation vehicles.

Key Responsibilities

Display & Graphics Stack Ownership: Design, develop, and maintain the display pipeline across both Android and non-Android platforms — focusing on SurfaceFlinger, Window Manager, and the Hardware Composer (HWC) HAL on Android, and equivalent compositor/display-server stacks such as Wayland/Weston and OpenWF Display (OpenWFD) on QNX/Linux-based systems.
Multi-Display Architecture: Engineer solutions for complex automotive display topologies, including Instrument Clusters, Central Infotainment (IVI), Passenger Displays, and Rear Seat Entertainment systems.
SoC Display Bring-Up & Integration: Partner directly with automotive infotainment SoC vendors to bring up and validate new display panels and interfaces on target hardware, spanning both Android and non-Android display stacks (e.g. OpenWF Display / OpenWFD on QNX-based systems, and Wayland/Weston compositors on Linux-based systems).
Performance Optimization: Analyze and optimize the graphics pipeline to ensure 60FPS+ performance, low latency, and efficient memory bandwidth usage. Debug VSYNC issues, frame drops, and jank.
HAL & Driver Integration: Work with SoC vendors to integrate and debug display drivers, ensuring proper communication between the Android Framework and the Kernel (DRM/KMS).
Stability & Robustness: Investigate and resolve stability issues such as screen freezes, black screens, and graphical artifacts. Analyze ANRs and native crashes related to the display/graphics stack.
Feature Development: Implement custom display features such as dynamic resolution switching, content mirroring, and hardware-accelerated layering/composition.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the Hardware, Kernel, and HMI Application teams to define requirements and resolve cross-layer dependencies.

Minimum Qualifications

BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of experience in embedded software development or platform engineering.
Strong proficiency in C++ and C. Familiarity with Java/Kotlin for Android Framework debugging.
Deep understanding of Android framework components like SurfaceFlinger, BufferQueue, and the Android display/graphics architecture.
Experience implementing or debugging HIDL/AIDL interfaces, specifically the Hardware Composer (HWC) or Gralloc.
Solid understanding of Linux OS internals, memory management (Ion/Dmabuf), and multi-threading.
Familiarity with low level display HW including Serializer/Deserializer, video links and display interfaces.
Hands-on experience integrating and bringing up new displays on automotive infotainment SoCs (e.g. Qualcomm Snapdragon Cockpit/Ride, NXP i.MX, TI Jacinto), including working knowledge of non-Android display compositor stacks such as OpenWF Display (OpenWFD) and Wayland/Weston.
Proficiency with version control systems like Git.

Preferred Qualifications

Low-Level Display: Knowledge of Linux DRM/KMS (Direct Rendering Manager / Kernel Mode Setting) subsystem and V4L2.
Automotive Standards: Experience with Android Automotive OS (AAOS) specific features like EVS (Exterior View System) or Cluster display management.
Functional Safety: Familiarity with display related automotive functional safety aspects.
Virtualization: Familiarity with display virtualization (VirtIO-GPU) and hypervisor environments (e.g., QNX, Gunyah).
SoC Experience: Experience bringing up display stacks on major automotive SoCs (Qualcomm Snapdragon, MediaTek, NXP, etc.).
Tools: Proficiency with performance profiling tools like Systrace, Perfetto, and vendor-specific GPU profilers.
Graphics APIs: Experience with OpenGL ES, Vulkan, or EGL.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial and high-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. Position: Advanced Automation Engineer - HSIO Overpass Solutions

Location: Nashua, NH / Valley Green, PA / Chicago, IL

Summary

The Advanced Automation Engineer will serve as a primary technical interface between Amphenol and customers developing automated or semi-automated systems for HSIO Overpass cable installation. This role will focus heavily on understanding customer automation requirements, identifying installation and process challenges, developing practical automation solutions, and driving technical issues to resolution.

The role will work closely with customer engineering, automation, manufacturing, and operations teams to evaluate applications, troubleshoot automation problems, develop proof-of-concept solutions, and recommend improvements to product design, tooling, fixtures, equipment, and installation processes. Internally, the engineer will connect customer requirements with product development, NPI, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams to ensure solutions are robust, scalable, and ready for production.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on problem solver who is comfortable working directly with customers, leading technical discussions, troubleshooting complex automation issues, and converting customer challenges into actionable engineering solutions.

Responsibilities

Serve as a primary customer-facing technical resource for automation, installation, handling, and manufacturability of HSIO Overpass cable solutions.
Build strong technical relationships with customer engineering, automation, manufacturing, and operations teams.
Engage directly with customers to understand automation requirements, installation challenges, production objectives, and system-level constraints.
Lead customer discussions and technical reviews to identify automation opportunities, risks, and potential solutions.
Act as the liaison between customer engineering teams and Amphenol product development, NPI, process engineering, quality, and operations.
Own and drive automation-related customer issues from problem identification through root-cause analysis, corrective action, validation, and closure.
Troubleshoot difficult automation and installation problems involving cable handling, routing, insertion, retention, orientation, fixturing, tooling, vision, force control, and product variation.
Quickly assess customer automation failures and determine whether the root cause is related to product design, tooling, equipment, process parameters, controls, handling, or operator interaction.
Develop practical, data-driven solutions to improve automation performance, repeatability, cycle time, yield, quality, and reliability.
Support customers during automation trials, equipment development, proof-of-concept builds, system integration, and production launch.
Participate in customer on-site trials and provide hands-on technical support during automation development and implementation.
Review customer automation concepts and provide recommendations to improve compatibility with HSIO Overpass products.
Conduct design-for-automation reviews for Overpass cable and interconnect products based on customer installation requirements.
Identify product design characteristics that may create automation challenges and recommend changes to improve handling, orientation, insertion, routing, retention, and repeatability.
Work with equipment suppliers and integrators to develop, troubleshoot, and optimize automation solutions.
Establish troubleshooting methods and standardized approaches for common Overpass automation challenges.
Identify opportunities for emerging automation technologies, robotics, machine vision, sensors, force control, and intelligent process monitoring.
Translate lessons learned from customer applications into product design guidelines, automation standards, and internal best practices.
Communicate customer requirements, technical findings, risks, action plans, and project status to internal leadership and cross-functional teams.
Develop and maintain process documentation, work instructions, training materials, validation plans, and automation troubleshooting guides.
Support the transition of successful customer automation concepts into scalable manufacturing processes.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Automation Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related technical discipline.
5+ years of experience in automation engineering, manufacturing engineering, process engineering, equipment engineering, or related technical role.
Strong experience troubleshooting automated manufacturing processes.
Demonstrated experience solving complex mechanical, process, tooling, equipment, and automation problems.
Strong understanding of Design for Manufacturability and Design for Automation principles.
Experience reviewing product designs and identifying potential automation and manufacturing risks.
Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, electrical schematics, control diagrams, and product documentation.
Strong understanding of mechanical systems, fixtures, tooling, sensors, pneumatics, actuators, motion-control systems, and automated material handling.
Strong root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving skills.
Ability to quickly diagnose problems and develop practical corrective actions under customer and production time constraints.
Strong customer-facing communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical problems and solutions clearly.
Ability to lead technical discussions with customer engineering and automation teams.
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to establish credibility and trust with customers.
Ability to manage multiple customer issues and projects simultaneously while maintaining strong follow-through.
Ability to travel domestically and internationally to support customers, suppliers, and manufacturing sites.

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting automation integration directly with OEM or Tier 1 customers.
Experience with automated installation of cables, connectors, wire harnesses, interconnects, or similar products.
Experience troubleshooting customer automation equipment and production processes.
Experience working with machine builders, system integrators, robotics integrators, and automation suppliers.
Experience taking a customer automation problem from initial investigation through proof-of-concept, validation, and production implementation.
Experience scaling automation from prototype or pilot production into high-volume manufacturing.
Experience developing automation roadmaps tied to capacity, labor efficiency, yield improvement, quality, reliability, and customer program timing.
Experience with rapid-response engineering and customer escalation environments.
Experience developing customer-facing technical presentations, proposals, feasibility studies, and problem-solving reports.
Experience mentoring automation engineers, process engineers, technicians, or equipment-development teams.

KEY SUCCESS FACTORS

Customer-Focused Problem Solver: Quickly understand customer automation challenges and take ownership of finding practical solutions.
Strong Customer Interaction: Build trusted relationships with customer engineering, automation, manufacturing, and operations teams.
Automation Troubleshooting: Diagnose problems across product design, tooling, equipment, controls, process parameters, and material handling.
Hands-On Engineering: Work directly with equipment, fixtures, tooling, products, and processes to identify and solve problems.
Root-Cause Ownership: Drive automation issues from initial problem identification through root cause, corrective action, validation, and closure.
Technical Communication: Clearly communicate complex automation problems, risks, recommendations, and solutions to customers and internal stakeholders.
Fast Response: Respond effectively to customer escalations and production issues where rapid technical problem-solving is critical.
Design for Automation: Identify automation risks early and influence product design to improve automated handling, installation, inspection, and production scalability.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Connect customers with product engineering, NPI, manufacturing, quality, operations, and suppliers to solve problems efficiently.
Continuous Improvement: Identify recurring customer and manufacturing issues and convert lessons learned into better products, processes, tooling, and automation standards.
Customer-to-Factory Translation: Convert customer application requirements into clear internal engineering, product, tooling, equipment, and process requirements.
Production Readiness: Ensure automation solutions developed with customers can be reliably scaled into repeatable, high-volume manufacturing.
